explanation: Zero at every D1 and D2 step, and zero at GO unless the previous trial went unrewarded after a streak of 2 or more losses, mostly late in the episode (trial 75 and later; before trial 70 it is almost always 0). In that case GO is about 4-8 while the agent keeps choosing a1, peaks at 9-10 on the GO where it switches from a1 to a2, then falls back to 0-3 on later GOs and to 0 once a trial is rewarded.
